City Council
AGENDA
la puente City Council Diana Giron, Acting City Clerk
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
APRIL 24, 2007
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCILMEMBERS: Solis, Lujan, Chavez, Storing, Perez
BOARD MEMBERS: Solis, Lujan, Chavez, Storing, Perez
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES OF AWARD TO PUENTE PRIDE AWARD WINNERS: CARMEN AND LILLIAN GARCIA; BILLIE TULLAI; AND THE PEREZ FAMILY
CERTIFICATES - Puente Pride
PRESENTATION OF PROCLAMATION RECOGNIZING APRIL 23 THROUGH APRIL 29, 2007 AS WEST NILE VIRUS AND VECTOR CONTROL AWARENESS WEEK
PROCLAMATION - West Nile Virus Week 2007
PRESENTATION OF PROCLAMATION RECOGNIZING THE MONTH OF APRIL 2007 AS LOS ANGELES COUNTY EARTHQUAKE AWARENESS MONTH
PROLAMATION - Earthquake Preparedness 2007
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Redevelopment Agency on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1.
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF MARCH 27, 2007
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of March 27, 2007.
3-27-07 Reg
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
None
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF MERRILL LYNCH INVESTMENT PROPOSAL
It is recommended that (1) the City Council direct Staff to leave its surplus cash with LAIF and not to transfer any LAIF deposits into the funds offered by Merrill Lynch; and (2) the City Council direct Staff to solicit bids or quotations for its custodial bank services and investment advisor services and contract with the most responsible proposer pursuant to the La Puente Municipal Code.
Merrill Lynch Rept
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1201 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2006-07
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution.
fin city warrant resolution warrant#1201
D-2
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM ROUND 2
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
CalHome Monthly Rpt
D-3
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FY 2006-07
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
CDBG Monthly Rpt-Mar07
D-4
APPROVAL OF DISPOSING OBSOLETE CITY COMPUTER AND ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) declare the listed computer equipment obsolete and without any substantial value; and (2) authorize the City Manager to initiate the disposal of the obsolete computer equipment at her discretion with Valley Vista Services' E-Waste collection program.
Surplus Computer Electronic Equipment Agenda Report
D-5
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR ASBESTOS AND LEAD TESTING SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council authorize Staff to issue the Request for Proposals for the asbestos and lead testing services.
Auth to solicit bids for asbestos & lead testing
D-6
AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR CENTRAL AVENUE RECONSTRUCTION PROJECT FROM MAIN STREET TO STIMSON AVENUE
It is recommended that the City Council award a contract in the amount of $218,293.30 to Gentry Brothers, Inc. for the Central Avenue Reconstruction Project from Main Street to Stimson Avenue.
Central Contract Award Rept
Central Avenue Agree
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
FINANCIAL REPORTS FOR MONTHS ENDED FEBRUARY 28, 2007 AND MARCH 31, 2007
It is recommended that the City Council approve and file the Financial Reports for the months ending February 28, 2007 and March 31, 2007.
FIN City Mo Fin as of 02-28-07
FIN City Mo Fin as of 03-31-07
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF SPONSORING A TABLE FOR TEN AT THE SAN GABRIEL POMONA VALLEY CHAPTER OF THE AMERICAN RED CROSS "HEROES CELEBRATION 2007"
It is recommended that the City Council approve a sponsorship in the amount of $500 for the San Gabriel Pomona Valley Chapter of the American Red Cross.
American Red Cross SponsorRept
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF PURSUING A JOINT USE AGREEMENT FOR USE OF FACILITIES WITH THE HACIENDA LA PUENTE UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT
Staff is recommending that the City Council direct Staff to proceed with further research and discussions with Hacienda La Puente Unified School District and the City Attorney regarding a Joint Use Agreement for facilities.
Joint Use Agreement with HLPUSD
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF SCHOLARSHIP AWARDS TO LA PUENTE RESIDENTS
It is recommended that the City Council authorize Staff to award 22 scholarships at $500 each for FY 2007-08.
Scholarship Report
E-5
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDING PROFESSIONAL SERVICES PURCHASING PROCEDURES
Staff recommends that the City Council (1) read the ordinance by title only and waive further reading; (2) introduce the Ordinance revising the purchasing limits relative to the award of contracts for professional services.
FIN Amending City Purchasing Policy-Professional Svc.
FIN purchasing limits. ordinance
E-6
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS SUPPORTING TWO ASSEMBLY BILLS AND ONE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVE BILL REGARDING THE SAN GABRIEL BASIN WATER QUALITY AUTHORITY (WQA)
None.
WQA Resos of Support
WQA Reso AB1010
WQA Reso AB1114
WQA Reso HR 123
E-7
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVING ALL MANAGEMENT SERVICES AGREEMENT FOR FISCAL YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2007 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2008
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Amendment to the Agreement with All City Management Services, Inc. in the amount of $14,256.
All City Agree Rept
E-8
REQUEST TO SUPPORT ASSEMBLY BILL 1657 (RUNNER AND TORRICO) (Requested by Council Member Solis)
None.
Support AB1657
RECESS CITY COUNCIL AND CONVENE THE REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
AB1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
Copies of reports relating to items on the Agenda are available for public inspection or purchase at City Hall. Questions regarding agenda items may be addressed to the City Clerk at 626/855-1500, extension 538. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk’s Office. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727, effective September 7, 1995.)
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL APRIL 24, 2007
AGENDA PAGE 5

Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.

CERTIFICATION

City Council
MINUTES
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL
REGULAR MEETING OF
April 24, 2007
A Regular Meeting of the City Council of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on April 24, 2007, at 07:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
PRESENTATION OF CERTIFICATES OF AWARD TO PUENTE PRIDE AWARD WINNERS: CARMEN AND LILLIAN GARCIA; BILLIE TULLAI; AND THE PEREZ FAMILY

PROCLAMATION - West Nile Virus Week 2007

PROLAMATION - Earthquake Preparedness 2007
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1.
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF MARCH 27, 2007
3-27-07 Reg
Chavez moved to approve the minutes of the regular meeting of March 27, 2007; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF MERRILL LYNCH INVESTMENT PROPOSAL
Merrill Lynch Rept
Perez moved to direct Staff to leave its surplus cash with LAIF and not to transfer any LAIF deposits into the funds offered by Merrill Lynch; and to solicit bids or quotations for its custodial bank services and investment advisor services and contract with the most responsible proposer pursuant to the La Puente Municipal Code; seconded by Storing.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
Action Taken : All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
Chavez moved to approve Consent Calendar Items D-1 through D-6; seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1201 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2006-07
fin city warrant resolution warrant#1201
D-2
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM ROUND 2
CalHome Monthly Rpt
D-3
APPROVAL OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FY 2006-07
CDBG Monthly Rpt-Mar07
D-4
APPROVAL OF DISPOSING OBSOLETE CITY COMPUTER AND ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT
Surplus Computer Electronic Equipment Agenda Report
D-5
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR ASBESTOS AND LEAD TESTING SERVICES
Auth to solicit bids for asbestos & lead testing
D-6
AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR CENTRAL AVENUE RECONSTRUCTION PROJECT FROM MAIN STREET TO STIMSON AVENUE
Central Contract Award Rept
Central Avenue Agree
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
FINANCIAL REPORTS FOR MONTHS ENDED FEBRUARY 28, 2007 AND MARCH 31, 2007
FIN City Mo Fin as of 02-28-07
FIN City Mo Fin as of 03-31-07
Chavez moved to approve and file the Financial Reports for the months ending February 28, 2007 and March 31, 2007; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF SPONSORING A TABLE FOR TEN AT THE SAN GABRIEL POMONA VALLEY CHAPTER OF THE AMERICAN RED CROSS "HEROES CELEBRATION 2007"
American Red Cross SponsorRept
Perez moved to approve a sponsorship in the amount of $500 for the San Gabriel Pomona Valley Chapter of the American Red Cross; seconded by Solis.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF PURSUING A JOINT USE AGREEMENT FOR USE OF FACILITIES WITH THE HACIENDA LA PUENTE UNIFIED SCHOOL DISTRICT
Joint Use Agreement with HLPUSD
Perez moved to receive and file the report to pursue a Joint Use Agreement for the use of facilities with the Hacienda La Puente Unified School District ; seconded by Chavez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF SCHOLARSHIP AWARDS TO LA PUENTE RESIDENTS
Scholarship Report
Solis moved to authorize Staff to award 20 scholarships at $500 each for FY 2007-08; seconded by Storing.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-5
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDING PROFESSIONAL SERVICES PURCHASING PROCEDURES
FIN Amending City Purchasing Policy-Professional Svc.
FIN purchasing limits. ordinance
Perez moved to read the ordinance by title only and waive further reading; seconded by Chavez.
Perez moved to introduce the Ordinance revising the purchasing limits relative to the award of contracts for professional services; seconded by Chavez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-6
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS SUPPORTING TWO ASSEMBLY BILLS AND ONE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVE BILL REGARDING THE SAN GABRIEL BASIN WATER QUALITY AUTHORITY (WQA)
WQA Resos of Support
WQA Reso AB1010
WQA Reso AB1114
WQA Reso HR 123
Storing moved to approve the support of two assembly bills and one house of representative bill regarding the San Gabriel Basin Water Quality Authority (WQA); seconded by Perez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-7
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVING ALL MANAGEMENT SERVICES AGREEMENT FOR FISCAL YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2007 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2008
All City Agree Rept
Solis moved to direct Staff to solicit proposals for school crossing guard services; seconded by Chavez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
E-8
REQUEST TO SUPPORT ASSEMBLY BILL 1657 (RUNNER AND TORRICO) (Requested by Council Member Solis)
Support AB1657
Solis moved to approve the support of Assembly Bill 1657 (Runner and Torrico); seconded by Chavez.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Solis, Storing, Chavez, and Perez. NOES: None.
RECESS CITY COUNCIL AND CONVENE THE REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
